text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. One common approach is supervised learning. In this method, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The system uses this data to build models, which are like mathematical rules. After training, these models can make predictions about new information they have never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy — how often the model gets the right answer. The more good training data a model receives, the better its predictions usually become.
